userStories.notes: Added CSRF protection to all state-changing calls, layered client + server. Client (comprehensive, transparent): the Supabase client's custom fetch (src/integrations/supabase/client.ts) now attaches the x-csrf-token header to every state-changing REST/RPC request (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) when a token is provisioned, so ALL PostgREST mutations (insert/update/delete) carry it without per-call changes; invokeEdgeFunction (src/lib/edge-functions.ts) attaches (and provisions) the token for state-changing edge-function invocations, covering admin-auth, secure-vault, process-accounting-document and every other function call. Added getStoredCSRFTokenSync() to src/lib/csrf.ts for the synchronous read used by the fetch layer. Wrapper artifact: created src/lib/secure-supabase.ts with ensureCsrfToken(), secureMutation(thunk) (provisions the token then runs a Supabase mutation), and secureInvokeEdgeFunction() as the auditable entry points for critical operations; wired the article delete mutation (ArticleManager) through secureMutation as a representative usage (all other mutations are already protected by the universal client-fetch layer). Server (edge functions): created supabase/functions/_shared/csrf.ts (validateCsrf/isStateChanging) enforcing the strict Origin allow-list (the real CSRF defense - a forged cross-site Origin is rejected) plus x-csrf-token presence as defense in depth; wired it into admin-auth, secure-vault, and process-accounting-document to 403 state-changing requests that fail validation. Added x-csrf-token to the edge-function CORS Access-Control-Allow-Headers so the preflight permits it. Note on the scheme: this is a header-token + Origin-allow-list model (the token lives in sessionStorage, not a cookie), so server-side 'validation' checks Origin (primary) and token presence (secondary) rather than a double-submit cookie match. The edge-function changes could not be exercised against the live self-hosted gateway from this environment, but the validator logic is unit-tested. Tests: added supabase/functions/_shared/__tests__/csrf.test.ts (5 Deno tests) and src/lib/__tests__/secure-supabase.test.ts (3 tests). Verification: 'npm run typecheck' clean; 'npm run lint' 0 errors; full unit suite 365 tests pass; Deno csrf+cors tests 14 pass; admin + contact E2E pass on chromium (edge/REST flows still work with the CSRF header attached).
